# TASK: Contact tab

## GOAL
Let visitors reach the studio directly by email.

## DATABASE
None. Email and socials come from /content/studio.ts (email = binauanders@gmail.com).

## UI
Components required:
- ContactCard — "Email us" button (mailto:binauanders@gmail.com?subject=Studio%20inquiry), email shown as text, address, socials
- QuickSubjects — optional buttons that prefill the subject: Booking, Festival, General

Pages affected:
- /app/contact/page.tsx

## VALIDATION (Zod)
Not needed (no form). Subjects are URL-encoded.

## BACKEND
- getStudio() → StudioInfo

## BEHAVIOR
1. Visitor opens Contact tab
2. Clicks "Email us" (or a quick subject)
3. Their email app opens addressed to binauanders@gmail.com with the subject filled in

## API ACTIONS
None.

## DONE WHEN
- [x] Every mailto link uses the email from /content/studio.ts, never a hard-coded string
- [x] Email address is also visible as text for people without a mail app
- [x] Works at all four breakpoints

## NOTES
No contact form or server code in v1.
